acceptance_repairs.given: An isolated Acceptance-consumer omission fixture omits only the Acceptance caller while all other inputs remain constant.

oracle.expected: Closure is rejected when the Acceptance caller is omitted.
forbidden: Closure is accepted when the Acceptance caller is omitted.
The omission fixture changes any input other than caller presence.
oracle.observable: The isolated omission fixture records the Acceptance consumer closure verdict as reject and verifies unchanged inputs.

acceptance_repairs.then: The Acceptance consumer returns closure reject for the omitted caller.
acceptance_repairs.when: Evaluate FR-9 closure for the Acceptance consumer with the omission fixture.
